Name: (CP) Desatured Seasonal Doghouse (a donutbunnybunny x SeaSea50 mash up)
Author: mrWAWA
Description:
This is a quick edit of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/donutbunnybunny?gameId=1303]donutbunnybunny[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31792?tab=description]Seasonal Doghouses and Pet Bowls for Vanilla[/url] to replace the [i]first[/i] doghouse using [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SeaSea50?gameId=1303]SeaSea50[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26865]Doghouse Recolour - Desaturated[/url]. Suggested by DummyAccount03.

[b]Installation
[/b]These are just .pngs and will do nothing by themselves. To install:
1. Download donutbunnybunny's amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31792]mod[/url] and it's requirements ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url])
2. Download this file and use it to [u]replace[/u] the .pngs in [i]"[CP] Seasonal Doghouses and Pet Bowls>assets>Doghouse"
[/i]*As mentioned, this only replaces the first doghouse as I wanted to have options. The second doghouse remains untouched from donutbunnybunny's original.

[b]Credits
[/b]All credits go to donutbunnybunny (especially for uploading .pngs!) and SeaSea50 for their original work, all I did was layer some .pngs.

[b]Permissions
[/b]Please follow the original creators permissions if you would like to edit these. Again, I can not stress enough how little I
contributed to doing this lol.
